scope: Exposed local development regressions; no model calls, production writes, deployment or scientific experiment.

observed_case.limitation: Public bounded history shows an unnecessary planning-only hop followed by actual native requests. It does not establish that unavailable tools caused every later unchanged continuation. Native call 270 request/response are only partially inspected.

questions: Does an active implementation repair retain its checkpoint and route to the native builder rather than data-only planning?
Can a stale/misrouted request or missing native edit/command tool be denied before provider admission?
Must a repaired candidate contain an actual experiment.py change, incident-bound executed checks and a frozen exact package before fresh scientific reviews?
pass_criteria: Planning-stage repair context is durably handed to building without a model call or attempt/budget reset.
No-progress remediation stays in building for repairs; unchanged recovery keys still stop instead of cycling indefinitely.
A newly available sibling package does not divert an unfinished repair to a planning-only tool surface.
Native configuration supplies read/write/edit/exec/process; missing tool schemas are denied before inference transport.
An immutable pre-repair checkpoint is hash verified. Unchanged experiment.py is rejected before executing tests or freezing a candidate.
Real temporary source edits and subprocess tests distinguish the retained original failure from corrected behavior. Model transport and persistence are fixtures, not live validation.
Existing uncertain-call fences, original claim/criteria, spending, deadline, cancellation and scientific review requirements remain unchanged.
